chunks: And it has also been narrated: “In the mosque of al-Madāʾin.”

key_terms.الْمَدَائِنِ: al-Madāʾin, the specific location mentioned in the report
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or transmitted
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ: mosque; the place in which the ruling is being applied

ai.seo_question: Is iʿtikaf permissible in the mosque of al-Madāʾin?
ai.summary: This report briefly indicates a legal ruling concerning the validity of iʿtikaf in the mosque of al-Madāʾin. It is cited as a transmitted basis for including that mosque among the places where iʿtikaf is permissible.
